restrictions: Messages are exactly 55 bytes, encoded from 2 independent uniform 256-bit words.
One batch of exactly n = 2^129 samples (an integer loop bound); all repeated messages are retained and charged; no restart or success amplification.
One selected 31-round compression or permutation per sample; single padded block or rate block; no parent or extra compression is ever evaluated.

Collision detection by deterministic stable LSD radix sort of the full 256-bit digest (eight 32-bit digit passes, 2^32 4-byte counters per pass) followed by one linear scan; no hashing table, no probing, and no distributional premise on digests.
Every ledger entry is a deterministic worst-case bound over all coin sequences and every fixed target; expected values are not used anywhere.
Classical 256-bit word RAM with independent uniform random words; all initialization, sorting, scanning and verification charged.
Analytical generic construction; no full-scale execution, precomputed collision, or empirical heuristic is claimed.
The nominal reference identifier does not assert an improvement; the conservative scalar bound is 129.11.
